# omni_folder (Resource)

Manages a content folder. Folders can be nested up to seven levels deep.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omni_folder" "finance" {
  name  = "Finance"
  path  = "finance"
  scope = "organization"
}

resource "omni_folder" "monthly_reporting" {
  name             = "Monthly reporting"
  parent_folder_id = omni_folder.finance.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the folder.

### Optional

- `breadcrumb_root` (Boolean) When `true`, breadcrumbs for this folder and its descendants start here, hiding ancestors and the scope crumb.
- `delete_recursively` (Boolean) When `true`, destroying this folder also deletes its documents and sub-folders (`force=true`). Defaults to `false`, which fails on a non-empty folder.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the folder owner. Required for `restricted` scope when using an organization API key.
- `parent_folder_id` (String) ID of the parent folder. Omit for a top-level folder.
- `path` (String) URL path segment for the folder. Lowercased by the API, and limited to alphanumeric characters and dashes. Changing it updates every descendant folder path.

  No `UseStateForUnknown` here on purpose: renaming a parent rewrites every descendant's path server side, so a child's path cannot be assumed to survive an update unchanged.
- `resolve_path_conflict` (Boolean) When `true`, path conflicts on update are resolved by appending a numeric suffix instead of returning a conflict error.
- `scope` (String) Folder scope. Defaults to `organization`, or the parent folder's scope when nested. A child folder's scope must match its parent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The folder's unique ID.
- `url` (String) Direct link to the folder in the Omni UI. Derived from the path, so it changes when an ancestor folder is renamed.
